data.long_meaning: The name Iti holds the essence of the divine elements of nature. It is derived from the Sanskrit language, and in Hinduism, it represents the sun and the moon. This name is ideal for parents who wish to bestow their child with a name that is both timeless and spiritual. The name Iti carries the meaning “Elemental” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Iti usually hope their child will grow to embody elemental and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Iti is a Sanskrit name that represents the divine elements of nature. It is derived from the words 'iti' which means 'thus' or 'so be it'. In Hinduism, it is believed that the name Iti carries the blessings of the sun and the moon. It is an ideal name for a baby girl and is considered to be a powerful name that can bring prosperity and success in life.
data.etymology: Iti belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Elemental.”
